message: Command `sed -n '6200,6260p' /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/S2OPC/src/Common/opcua_types/sopc_builtintypes.c; echo "==="; grep -n "SOPC_BuiltInType_EncodingTable" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/S2OPC/src/Common/opcua_types/sopc_builtintypes.c | head` executed with exit code 0.

message.content:
The decode function uses `getPfnDecode(desc)` which accesses `SOPC_BuiltInType_EncodingTable[desc->typeIndex]` for built-in types. The vulnerability is an OOB access in the builtintype tables. Let me look at `SOPC_BuiltInType_EncodingTable` and `SOPC_BuiltInType_HandlingTable` definitions, and understand what `desc->typeIndex` can be.

Let me look at the builtintypes.c table definitions and the encoding table.
